releaseNotes:
• Added Notification Bar Attendance & Shortage Alerts: dismissible visual mini-dashboard with circular attendance ring, lowest-attendance subject progress bars sorted first, and quick Sync Now / Switch / Portal actions
• Built-in Lock-Screen Privacy Mode (VISIBILITY_PRIVATE) hides your name, subjects, and exact percentages on the lock screen until unlocked
• Added Settings → Notification Bar Alerts controls (85% / 75% threshold, alert-only mode, and live Preview button)
